dogs.title: Hulk

dogs.title: Virgil

dogs.title: Elizabeth

dogs.title: Marie
dogs.description: A wig taller than the dog with a model ship in it, panniered gown, a slice of cake held out.

dogs.title: Barack

dogs.title: Donald

dogs.title: Batman

dogs.title: Judy
dogs.description: A pointer planted barking between ragged men and a raised stick. Brave, never pitiable.

dogs.title: Elliott
